source_data.desc:
A creature with two legs and a flat tail emerges from the water. Its wide mouth opens, revealing a spiked tongue._  
**Luring with Thirst.** The vallowex haunts woodland rivers, luring in prey with its thirst-inducing aura. When a creature stops to drink, the vallowex attacks and drags the creature into the water to feast. Reproduce through Hosts. Vallowexes release eggs into potable water. After a creature drinks the eggs, a tadpole hatches in its stomach. The tadpole slowly consumes the host from the inside out, emerging as a vallowex when the host dies.
source_data.name: Vallowex
source_data.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 14
source_data.special_abilities_json: [{"name": "Amphibious", "desc": "The vallowex can breathe air and water."}, {"name": "Aura of Thirst", "desc": "At the start of each of the vallowex's turns, each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on its next attack roll or ability check as a gnawing thirst distracts it. For each minute a creature stays in the vallowex's aura, it gains one level of exhaustion from dehydration. A level of exhaustion is removed if the creature uses an action to drink 1 pint of water. A vallowex is immune to its own Aura of Thirst as well as the auras of other vallowexes."}, {"name": "Underwater Camouflage", "desc": "The vallowex has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater."}]

en.description:
A creature with two legs and a flat tail emerges from the water. Its wide mouth opens, revealing a spiked tongue._  
**Luring with Thirst.** The vallowex haunts woodland rivers, luring in prey with its thirst-inducing aura. When a creature stops to drink, the vallowex attacks and drags the creature into the water to feast. Reproduce through Hosts. Vallowexes release eggs into potable water. After a creature drinks the eggs, a tadpole hatches in its stomach. The tadpole slowly consumes the host from the inside out, emerging as a vallowex when the host dies.
en.name: Vallowex

ru.description:
Существо с двумя ногами и плоским хвостом выходит из воды. Его широкий рот открывается, показывая шипастый язык.

**Заманивание жаждой.** Валловекс населяет лесные реки, заманивая добычу своей аурой, вызывающей жажду. Когда существо останавливается, чтобы напиться, валловекс атакует и тащит существо в воду, чтобы пировать. Размножение через хозяев. Валловексы выпускают яйца в питьевую воду. После того как существо выпьет яйца, головастик вылупляется в его желудке. Головастик медленно потребляет хозяина изнутри наружу, появляясь как валловекс, когда хозяин умирает.
ru.name: Валловекс
